newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met down as Kleinwort trims forecast.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met down as Kleinwort trims forecast.

text.p: Shares in Grand Metropolitan Plc dipped against a firm overall UK stock market trend on Tuesday as analysts at Kleinwort Benson lowered their earnings estimate on the stock, traders said.
The stock was down 5p at 459 by 1439 GMT, even as the FTSE 100 index rose 21.6 points to 4,060.1.

Market sources said Kleinwort analysts shaved 25 million stg off their estimate for GrandMet's pre-tax profit in fiscal 1997 to 1.005 million stg. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
